record.body: Signature animal vocal communication is an original Signature-made system of designed calls, built as counterparts to real animal calls and clearly labeled Signature throughout. Instead of copying any real species' call, each Signature call is designed from scratch: a simple tone pattern with a stated function, such as a Signature contact call, a Signature alarm call, and a Signature assembly call, each defined by its pitch contour, duration, and repetition pattern. These designs are teaching tools: they show how a communication system can be built from a small set of signals, and they are never presented as field data from any real animal. This record covers the biophony layer in its Signature form: sounds a living Signature creature would make, kept distinct from Signature geophony and Signature anthrophony.

record.science_proof: Science proof: the design follows the same sender-receiver test used for real calls: a Signature call counts as a signal only if a stated receiver response is defined for it, and the pair defines that response for every Signature call it introduces.
